name: Algorithm Analysis and Asymptotic Complexity
learning_objective: Describe and compare the running time of algorithms using asymptotic (Big-O) notation as a function of input size.

name: Arrays and Linked Lists
learning_objective: Compare array-based and linked-list-based storage in terms of memory layout, access time, and insertion or deletion cost.

name: Stacks and Queues
learning_objective: Explain the LIFO and FIFO access restrictions of stacks and queues and identify appropriate use cases for each.

name: Searching
learning_objective: Trace and compare linear search and binary search and explain why binary search requires sorted data.

name: Bubble, Selection, Insertion, Merge, and Quick Sort
learning_objective: Trace bubble, insertion, selection, merge, and quick sort on a small input and compare their asymptotic running times.

name: Hashing and Collision Handling
learning_objective: Explain how a hash function maps keys to table positions and how collisions are detected and resolved.

name: Trees, Heaps, Graphs, and Fundamental Traversals
learning_objective: Explain the structural properties of binary search trees and heaps and trace fundamental graph traversal order.
